lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's two hundred sixty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 260? Nope!

lines.text: Join four corners of a regular thirteen-sided shape.
lines.caption: Join 4 corners of a regular 13-sided shape.

lines.text: How many choices hold the center?
lines.caption: How many choices hold the center?

lines.text: That's seven hundred fifteen choices. Count the misses!
lines.caption: That's 715 choices. Count the misses!

lines.text: It misses when all four corners fit in one half.
lines.caption: It misses when all 4 corners fit in one half.

lines.text: Take the first corner. The other three come from the next six: twenty ways.
lines.caption: Take the first corner. The other 3 come from the next 6: 20 ways.

lines.text: Thirteen first corners times twenty: two hundred sixty misses.
lines.caption: 13 first corners times 20: 260 misses.

lines.text: Seven hundred fifteen minus two hundred sixty is four hundred fifty-five!
lines.caption: 715 minus 260 is 455!

lines.text: Two hundred sixty was the trap: just the misses!
lines.caption: 260 was the trap: just the misses!

lines.text: Did you get four hundred fifty-five? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 455? Tell me below!
